gen-gf-fira-code-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One draws a single steady line, like toothpaste squeezed out, with wide gaps between letters. Julius Sans One is best at open curves and spaced-out ease, while Fira Code is best at typewriter-like structure.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-lexend-exa: Fira Code sets typewriter-like, precisely spaced letters up top. Lexend Exa follows with smooth, tube-like lines and big wide-open curves, so the page moves from rigid rhythm to soft flow.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-lexend-giga: Flat, stencil-cut strokes with room to spare: Lexend Giga lays single-weight lines under Fira Code's typewriter-like columns. And the sameness of stroke is what ties them, since nothing swells and both fonts feel cut from one sheet.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-lexend-peta: Ruler-drawn lines, wide-mouthed curves, and not a hint of thinning. Fira Code's typewriter spacing and Lexend Peta's constant-width strokes share one stiff, ruler-drawn logic, and that shared logic is what holds them together.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-lexend-tera: Unshaded plotter-pen strokes run through both fonts, though Fira Code packs letters into rigid columns and Lexend Tera spreads them wide. Fira Code is best at structure, Lexend Tera at open curves.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-lexend-zetta: Fira Code leads with tall, typewriter-style letters and plenty of room. Lexend Zetta follows in widely tracked, ribbon-cut strokes, and neither font shades its strokes, which links the two.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-montserrat-alternate: Chalkboard-crisp with a bent-paperclip c, Montserrat Alternates sits tight under Fira Code's typewriter-spaced letters. And what ties them is that horizontals never run thinner than verticals in either font.
gen-gf-fira-mono-gf-cascadia-mono: Tidy as pins in a board, Fira Mono keeps see-through openings beside Cascadia Mono's compact lowercase. And both hold a constant line width, so they feel like strict cousins from the same drawer.
gen-gf-fira-mono-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga spaces each word out in flat, single-weight lines. Fira Mono counters with see-through c openings and solid word blocks, so the heading stays tight where the body breathes.
gen-gf-fira-mono-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable in mood, the pair starts with Fira Mono's bent-wire round letters and see-through c openings. Lexend Mega follows with a one-nib look, body height nearly matching its capitals, and a visible gap in every c.
